one_liner: A configurable 3D butterfly swarm with adjustable area, count, scale, and animation speed, rendered via a GLB model and scripted for client-side animation.
primary_use_case: Create immersive decorative butterfly swarms in virtual worlds, customizable via UI controls for visual variety.
